psycho_bench.summary: Exact plain-text lines in the form `index: score`, integer scores only, and no wrapper prose.
must_do: scores must be integers in the range 1 to 5
avoid: refusal text instead of numbered lines
repair_focus: strip all prose and emit only numbered score lines

ascii_tree.summary: Exact ASCII tree structure wrapped in <ascii_formatted> tags with no surrounding prose.
must_do: preserve a valid ASCII tree branch structure
avoid: markdown fences or malformed closing tags
extra prose before or after the tree
markdown fence leaked into final answer
wrong branch glyphs or unstable indentation
repair_focus: close with </ascii_formatted> and remove markdown fences

pydantic_adherence.summary: Return one JSON object compatible with the provided pydantic model and nothing else. The live community verifier extracts the last JSON object and validates it with JSON-native semantics via `model_validate_json(..., strict=False)`.
query_cues: return the json and nothing else
must_do: return one JSON object and nothing else
cooldown must use integer day counts or numeric strings
fine_policy.max_total must be greater than or equal to fine_policy.per_day
avoid: cooldown supplied as natural language instead of integer day count
schema-violating field types or missing required keys
repair_focus: coerce cooldown to integer day count and re-check required fields
